commercial_properties.details: Service card with id='commercial', includes Schools & universities, Apartment complexes, Office buildings, Retail centers features

monthly_subscription_days_of_month.details: Grid of 1-31 day buttons, users select specific days of each month for service

unpaid_subscriptions.details: Shows subscription clients with failed payments, currently shows empty state with message
